tools.name: list_my_pages
tools.title: List my LinkMAX pages
tools.description: List all link-in-bio pages that belong to the signed-in LinkMAX user. Returns slug, title, publish status, view count and update time.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: list_my_leads
tools.title: List my LinkMAX leads
tools.description: List recent leads captured by the signed-in LinkMAX user's pages. Returns contact fields and source page.

page_id.description: Optional page UUID to filter leads by page.

tools.name: get_analytics_summary
tools.title: Get analytics summary
tools.description: Return a lightweight analytics summary for the signed-in LinkMAX user: total events, unique visitors and top pages within the given number of days (default 30).

tools.name: create_page
tools.title: Create a new LinkMAX page
tools.description: Create a new link-in-bio page for the signed-in LinkMAX user. Returns the new page id, slug and default settings so the agent can immediately edit blocks and appearance.

slug.description: Desired URL slug (lowercase). If omitted or already taken, a unique slug is generated.

title.description: Page title shown in the header and SEO.

tools.name: get_page_structure
tools.title: Get page structure and blocks
tools.description: Return the full block structure and current configuration of one of the signed-in user's LinkMAX pages, so an agent can review and edit it. Accepts either a page_id (uuid) or a slug.

page_id.description: Page UUID. Provide this OR slug.

slug.description: Page slug. Provide this OR page_id.

tools.name: create_block
tools.title: Create a block on a page
tools.description: Create a new block on one of the signed-in LinkMAX user's pages. Supports all block types: link, text, image, button, video, socials, product, form, messenger, map, separator and more. For a link block pass `url` and `title`. The block is appended at the end of the page unless `position` is given. Returns the created block.

page_id.description: UUID of the page to add the block to.

url.description: For link/button/download/video blocks: the target URL.

content.description: Full block content object (JSON). All block fields in one place, e.g. { title, url, icon, style, blockStyle, ... }. `page_id`, `type` and `position` are handled separately.

position.description: Zero-based position on the page. Defaults to append at the end.

tools.name: update_block
tools.title: Update a block's content and design
tools.description: Update the content and/or design (style) of an existing block on one of the signed-in LinkMAX user's pages. Pass `content` with the fields to change (title, url, icon, style, blockStyle, background, etc) and/or `style` for the block's design settings. `title` can be set directly. Returns the updated block.

block_id.description: UUID of the block to update.

content.description: Block content fields to merge into the existing content JSON, e.g. { title, url, icon, style, blockStyle }. Omitted fields keep their current value.

style.description: Block design settings to merge into the existing style JSON, e.g. { padding, borderRadius, shadow, hoverEffect, animation, background }. Omitted fields keep their current value.

title.description: Optional new block title (also merged into content.title).

position.description: Optional new zero-based position on the page.

tools.name: update_page
tools.title: Update a page's design and settings
tools.description: Update the appearance and settings of one of the signed-in LinkMAX user's pages: title, description, avatar, theme (theme_settings), SEO meta, publish state. Pass only the fields to change. Returns the updated page.

page_id.description: UUID of the page to update.

title.description: New page title shown in header and SEO.

is_published.description: Set true to publish the page, false to unpublish.

theme_settings.description: Page theme/design settings to merge, e.g. { background, font, accent, layout, spacing }. Omitted keys keep current values.

seo_meta.description: SEO meta object to merge, e.g. { title, description, ogImage }.
